verdict.rationale: Auth0 issues Machine-to-Machine credentials via the Client Credentials flow, where an application authenticates with its Client ID and Secret to get an Access Token, and it handles authorization through scopes and granular permissions explicitly including M2M. Its AI offering adds a unique digital identity per agent, delegated OAuth calls that keep agents from having broad, unrestricted access, and Token Vault so agents never handle third-party API keys directly. Missing for 10: detailed docs on restricting an agent's credential to specific scopes or permissions (client grants), credential rotation and expiry controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
